Description:
Competitive operating
environment as a result of action
from other players (existing and
new entrants)

Inability to service our financial
obligations as and when they fall
due
Mitigating actions:
• Implementation of various initiatives to
improve efficiency across the Group.

Description:
Occurrence of incidences that
threaten the safety and security
of our customers and employees
or result into damage of assets
Mitigating actions:
• Continuous safety and security risk
assessment and prompt resolution of gaps
identified;
• Strict adherence to security policy and
procedures;
• Regular training on safety and security
matters; and
• Close collaboration with relevant security
authorities.

Description:
Fluctuations in the fuel prices
driven by global crude oil prices
Mitigating actions:
• Competitive sourcing of fuel suppliers;
• Continuous monitoring of trends in global
fuel prices; and
• Fuel hedging arrangements.

Description:
Inability to repatriate funds
trapped in some of the markets
that we operate in.
Mitigating actions:
• Continuous monitoring of economic
performance of our markets;
• Ticket sales in hard currencies in risky
markets; and
• Continuous engagement with relevant
government authorities in those markets.

Description:
Possible negative impact on the
operations as a result of political
changes or instability affecting
our markets.
Mitigating actions:
• Continuous monitoring of political activities
across different markets;
• Wide network coverage and destinations; and
• Close collaboration and engagement with
relevant stakeholders and governments.

Description:
Legal action arising from normal
cause of business with third par-
ties or employees
Mitigating actions:
• Strict adherence to contractual terms; and
• Involvement of internal and external legal
counsel.

Description:
Failure to comply with various
regulatory requirements thereby
resulting into fines and penalties
Mitigating actions:
• Continuous monitoring of changes in laws
and regulations; and
• Established mechanisms to ensure strict
compliance and continuous monitoring of
compli ance.
